SOGROM_DICETRAY.Title: Dice Tray
SOGROM_DICETRAY.SettingShowHint: Set Dice Tray to be visible by default.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.SettingThemeHint: Choose the visual theme for the dice tray.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.LayoutMenuHint: Choose which dice buttons every player's tray shows, in which rows, and how they look. Add extra dice, Fate dice, exploding dice or chat commands.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.LayoutHint: Click a button to edit it, drag it to move it, and right-click or use × to remove it. Drop a button on the middle of another to put it in that button's drawer: players hold the button to open it. Changes reach every player's tray when you save.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.LayoutNestedDrawer: A button that has its own drawer can't go inside another drawer.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.LayoutDrawerFull: A drawer holds at most {max} buttons.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.LayoutEmpty: No rows yet. Saving an empty layout goes back to the default dice.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.LayoutRemoveRowConfirm: Remove this row and every button on it?
SOGROM_DICETRAY.LayoutRowFull: A row holds at most {max} buttons.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.LayoutInvalidFormula: "{formula}" isn't a single dice term (such as d6, 4dF or d6x) or a chat command starting with /.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.ButtonFormulaHint: What one click adds to the pool: a die such as d6, several such as 4dF, or a die with modifiers such as d6x (exploding). Or a chat command starting with /, which runs straight away.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.ButtonLabelHint: Text shown on the button when it has no image.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.ButtonImageHint: Leave empty to use the built-in icon for standard dice.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.ButtonColorHint: Tints the button's image, or colours its label.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.SettingPopoutButtonHint: Where the button that opens the dice tray in its own window appears in the scene controls on the left.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.SettingPopoutAutoOpen: Open the Pop-out Tray on Load
SOGROM_DICETRAY.SettingPopoutAutoOpenHin: Opens the dice tray in its own window whenever you join the world.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.SettingRightClickHint: What right-clicking a die in the tray does: take one of that die out of the pool, or roll a single one of that die straight away without changing the pool.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.KeybindingToggleTray: Show or Hide the Dice Tray
SOGROM_DICETRAY.KeybindingToggleTrayHint: The same as clicking the d20 button above the chat input.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.KeybindingTogglePopout: Open or Close the Pop-out Tray
SOGROM_DICETRAY.KeybindingTogglePopoutHi: Shows the dice tray in its own window, which you can move anywhere on screen.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.KeybindingRollPoolHint: Rolls the dice you have added to the tray, as if you clicked Roll.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.KeybindingClearPoolHint: Empties the tray: dice, keep modifiers, roll mode and modifier.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.EmptyPool: Add some dice to your pool first!
SOGROM_DICETRAY.RollError: Invalid dice formula. Please check your input.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.CommandError: The chat command {command} failed. Check the console (F12) for details.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.TooltipModifierInput: Modifier: type a number, or scroll to change it. Enter rolls.
SOGROM_DICETRAY.Pf2eFortuneTooltip: Fortune: roll twice and use the higher result
SOGROM_DICETRAY.Pf2eMisfortuneTooltip: Misfortune: roll twice and use the lower result
SOGROM_DICETRAY.Pf2eFlatCheck5: DC 5 flat check: succeeds on a 5 or higher
SOGROM_DICETRAY.Pf2eFlatCheck11: DC 11 flat check: succeeds on an 11 or higher
SOGROM_DICETRAY.DaggerheartDuality: Duality roll (hold for a Hope or Fear roll)
SOGROM_DICETRAY.DaggerheartFateHope: Fate roll with the Hope die
SOGROM_DICETRAY.DaggerheartFateFear: Fate roll with the Fear die
SOGROM_DICETRAY.DaggerheartAdvantageTool: Advantage: add a d6 to the roll
SOGROM_DICETRAY.DaggerheartDisadvantageT: Disadvantage: take a d6 from the roll
SOGROM_DICETRAY.SwadeAcingDie: Add a die that aces (explodes on its highest roll)
SOGROM_DICETRAY.SwadeWildTooltip: Wild Card: roll the Wild Die alongside and keep the higher
SOGROM_DICETRAY.DemonlordBoonTooltip: Boon: add a d6 to the roll
SOGROM_DICETRAY.DemonlordBaneTooltip: Bane: take a d6 from the roll
